notes: Controlled vocabulary for tagging Kent Kiehl's publications (clinical cognitive neuroscience: psychopathy, antisocial behaviour, psychosis, substance use, brain imaging, neuroscience and law). 'topic' and 'approach' are multi-valued; 'type' is single-valued. Chip colour = axis colour.

values.label: Psychopathy
values.def: Psychopathic traits or psychopathy as assessed by the PCL-R, PCL:YV, LSRP or related instruments; callous-unemotional traits.

values.label: Youth & development
values.def: Adolescent or juvenile samples, conduct disorder, incarcerated youth, developmental questions.

values.label: Women & sex differences
values.def: Female offenders, incarcerated women, or explicit sex/gender comparisons.

values.label: Antisocial behaviour & violence
values.def: Criminal offending, aggression, homicide, violence, externalizing psychopathology.

values.label: Risk & recidivism prediction
values.def: Prediction of rearrest, reoffending, treatment outcome or mortality from clinical, behavioural or brain measures (neuroprediction).

values.label: Moral judgment, empathy & emotion
values.def: Moral decision-making, empathy, affective processing, emotion recognition, emotional intelligence.

values.label: Attention & cognitive control
values.def: Oddball/target detection, response inhibition, error monitoring, attention, executive function, language and memory processes.

values.label: Substance use & addiction
values.def: Alcohol, stimulant, cannabis or other substance use disorders, craving, relapse, treatment of addiction.

values.label: Schizophrenia & psychosis
values.def: Schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, psychosis risk and related psychotic disorders.

values.label: Other clinical conditions
values.def: Anxiety and obsessive-compulsive disorders, hoarding, ADHD, depression, PTSD and other psychiatric conditions.

values.label: Traumatic brain injury
values.def: Traumatic brain injury and concussion in forensic, athletic or community samples.

values.label: Trauma & adversity
values.def: Childhood maltreatment, trauma exposure, adverse experiences and their correlates.

values.label: Sexual offending & paraphilias
values.def: Sexual offending, sexual sadism, paraphilic disorders.

values.label: Neuroscience & law
values.def: Use of neuroscience in the legal system, sentencing, responsibility, ethics and policy.

values.label: Basic & comparative neuroscience
values.def: Normative cognitive neuroscience in healthy participants, ageing, and comparative work (including cetacean hearing).

values.label: Functional MRI
values.def: Task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging.

values.label: Structural MRI
values.def: Gray matter volume or density, cortical thickness, voxel- or source-based morphometry, brain age.

values.label: Connectivity & ICA
values.def: Resting-state or task functional connectivity, independent component analysis, network analyses, dynamic connectivity.

values.label: Diffusion imaging
values.def: Diffusion tensor imaging and white-matter microstructure.

values.label: EEG & event-related potentials
values.def: Electroencephalography, event-related potentials (P3, ERN, N400 and others), MEG.

values.label: Genetics & physiology
values.def: Imaging genetics, genome-wide or candidate-gene analyses, hormones and peripheral physiology.

values.label: Machine learning
values.def: Classification, prediction or pattern-recognition models applied to clinical or brain data.

values.label: Assessment & psychometrics
values.def: Development, validation or factor structure of clinical and self-report instruments; interview- and file-based assessment.

values.label: Behavioural & survey studies
values.def: Behavioural tasks, questionnaires, epidemiological or records-based analyses without brain imaging as the main measure.

values.label: Treatment & intervention
values.def: Clinical trials and treatment studies, including cognitive remediation, mindfulness and medication.

values.label: Methods & tools
values.def: New acquisition or analysis methods, software, hardware, multi-site or mobile-MRI methodology.

values.label: Empirical
values.def: Original research report.

values.label: Review & theory
values.def: Reviews, theoretical papers, meta-analyses and encyclopedia entries.

values.label: Methods
values.def: Papers whose main contribution is a method, tool or protocol.

values.label: Commentary
values.def: Commentaries, replies, editorials, letters and retraction notices.

values.label: Book chapter
values.def: Chapters in edited volumes and popular-press articles.

values.label: Book
values.def: Authored or edited books.
